failure.cause: A peak-length native row reached the allocator boundary after 91 successful serialized updates; expandable segments retained enough fragmented unallocated cache that a 48 MiB frozen-MLP activation could not be placed.

rejected_resolution: Full native saved-tensor CPU offload was previously shown to trigger the Linux host OOM killer and remains forbidden.
decision: This is an execution failure, not a benchmark or model-quality result. Explicitly release the CUDA allocator cache between serialized native row graphs, rerun the signed four-GPU preflight, and restart Stage 1 from exact R12 with the identical data, objective, batch, and optimizer schedule.
